<@583892532644151312> I merged this, but then realized it breaks all the existing links to upgrades specs, which seems worse than the confusion caused right now (that people have lived with for a while 😅 )

I think we should still do it, but do it in the context of a broader "refresh" of the repo, where we potentially also link to EELS, see: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/826
